{{recipe}}

From the original recipe contributor:<blockquote>"The salad recipe reminds me of those quiet and peaceful Sunday brunches at the local corner bakery and is an attempt to duplicate the bakery's original, secret recipe."</blockquote>

== Ingredients ==

*  16 [[Cookbook:Oz|oz]] (1 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]]) [[Cookbook:Pasta|angel hair pasta]]
*  ⅛ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Sesame Oil|sesame oil]]
*  [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]], if needed
*  1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] table [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*  1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] or more finely-[[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] fresh [[Cookbook:Cilantro|cilantro]]
*  ½ cup chopped fresh [[Cookbook:Scallion|scallions]]
*  1 ½ cups thinly-[[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] fresh [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrots]]

== Procedure ==

#  Cook angel hair pasta according to package instructions, then drain.
#  Add sesame oil, olive oil, and salt (to taste) to drained pasta
#  Toss in cilantro, scallions, and carrots.
#  Chill before serving.
